expected_outcome.description: Block the change: the new duplicate handler in `src/routes/documents.ts` checks only `view` on the source folder (line 60) and never checks `edit` on the folder it writes into (line 62), unlike every other handler that creates or changes a document. A user can therefore create documents in any folder by passing its id as `targetFolderId`, including other teams' folders, or in a folder they may only view by omitting it. A blocking finding must identify the missing edit check on the target folder and fix it, for example with `assertCan(req.session.user, "edit", targetFolderId ?? source.folderId)` before the create.
